lastCompletedStory.title: Push BLOCKED line on review dispatch 'blocked' path so the orchestrator never hangs on a failed review

nextStoryContext: US-005 added opts.notifyOrchestrator?.(`[cam] review BLOCKED: ${detail}`) in loop.ts at the blocked-review path (before notifyTerminal). The existing notify-orchestrator.test.ts test 5 was updated from 'NOT called' to 'IS called with [cam] review BLOCKED:' (correct per the new AC). A new test in loop.test.ts pins the same invariant independently.
